title: Error communicating with CareLink Server
body:
Good morning, for a few days now my xdrip has not updated the data from CareLink, the app displays "Error communicating with CareLink Server! Please try later!"
I uninstalled XDrip and reinstalled latest version, but in settings when I go to login (Login with browser) the app displays the above error. I checked that my users are working on CareLink personal and everything is ok.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f727751a-b647-4b94-b777-eeb00b8bf869)

comments.body: You are not supposed to open an issue as explained in the note you would have seen when you went through the steps to open this.
